#1. creating figures for basidiospore data to compare sizes

--text take .csv files with spore data for a single specimen and make scatter plots with data

Set working directory, make sure it is the right directory, load 30181 data as spores

```{r}
setwd("~/Desktop/wiscam_microscopy/data/rt_basidiospore") #set your working directory
getwd() #use to see what your current working directory is
spores1 <- read.csv("30181_basidiospore.csv")
spores2 <- read.csv("30182_basidiospore.csv")
spores3 <- read.csv("30183_basidiospore.csv")

spores1$Sample <- "30181"
spores2$Sample <- "30182"
spores3$Sample <- "30183"

str(spores1)
str(spores2)
str(spores3)

head(spores) #sanity check to make sure data loaded
```
#make a scatter plot -24
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(spores1, aes(x = Length, y = Width)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 3) +
   xlim(0, 15) +
  ylim(0, 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Basidiospore Measurements",
    x = "Length (µm)",
    y = "Width (µm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
all_spores <- rbind(spores1, spores2, spores3)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(all_spores, aes(x = Width, y = Length, color = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("30181" = "darkblue",
                                "30182" = "blue",
                                "30183" = "pink")) +
  xlim(0, 20) +
  ylim(0, 20) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Basidiospore Measurements",
    x = "Width (µm)",
    y = "Length (µm)"
  )

```
